column1: # Minimum expected PNG count per full-copy vendor (no curation list drives these).
# Semantics: test_icon_sync_completeness.sh asserts the actual dist/<vendor>
# PNG count is >= min_count. A legitimate upstream addition (via the weekly
# update-icons.yml cron PR) raises the real count above the floor and does
# NOT fail the gate; a partial-sync regression (fewer files than the floor)
# DOES. Bump a floor here only when an intentional curation/scope change
# Curation-driven vendors (Devicon, FluentUI) are NOT listed here — their
# completeness is checked against the curation fixture directly.
